Cocktails.title: Signature Cocktails
Cocktails.desc: Transport yourself back to the heartwarming nostalgia of Ethiopian childhood with our signature cocktails. Each one is lovingly named after a cherished Habesha memory. Embrace the joy as we invite you to relish in the beauty of traditional Habesha culture through the art of mixology. Cheers to the timeless spirit of Ethiopia!

Cocktails.title: From Gojo with Love
Cocktails.desc: (Tequila, triple sec, watermelon, berbere, lime) This delightful libation embodies the lively, welcoming spirit of Ethiopian hospitality. Our twist on a margarita, the fusion of tequila, lime and watermelon uplifts the cocktail, while a sprinkle of bebere brings a touch of heat and aromatic spice which will instantly transport you to the warmth and love found in an Ethiopian home

Cocktails.title: Segno Maksegno
Cocktails.desc: (Gin, lemon verbena honey, bessobella, cucumber) Segno maksegno (which also means "Monday Tuesday" (in english) is the Ethiopian version of hopscotch. As you raise your glass to take the first sip the aromas of local lemon verbena and bessobella blend beautifully, inviting you to savor the symphony where worries are forgotten, and the world seems to glow in the warmth of the sunlit afternoon

Cocktails.title: Biy Champion
Cocktails.desc: (Coffee bean bourbon, cascara & mango cordial, house ginger beer) Presenting the biy champion, an invigorating cocktail inspired by the game played by children across the diaspora (where it is also called marbles, pitch and many others depending on region). The marriage of coffee infused bourbon and traditional Trinidadian ginger beer is as playful as the game itself where children compete to see who can shoot their marbles into the hole or knock other marbles out of the game

Cocktails.title: Konjo Girl
Cocktails.desc: (Dark rum, bisaap, lavender, guava, spiced sugar) The konjo girl is a toast to the breathtaking beauty of the women of Ethiopia and a love song to the pulse of its vibrant culture. A smooth and velvety mix of dark rum and guava add tropical notes while lavender and hibiscus give a subtle, floral dimension to this delicious elixir

Cocktails.title: Desta Dream
Cocktails.desc: (Gin, elderflower liqueur, koseret cordial, fresh mint, soda) In this cocktail we have managed to capture the essence of happiness and pour it into a glass. The gin's bouquet tickles your senses, while the elderflower liqueur adds a touch of sweetness. But it's the presence of koseret that truly makes it special & unique. This beloved Ethiopian herb infuses the drink with its comforting aroma and earthiness. As you take your first sip, a smile will naturally find its way to your lips

Cocktails.title: Tiba Tibae
Cocktails.desc: (Vodka, apricot liqueur, coconut, pineapple, papaya) This enticing libation blends the luscious flavors of vodka, coconut, and apricot liqueur, pineapple and papaya bringing the spirit of Tiba Tibae to life in every sip. The game, Tiba Tibae is this fun game played by Habesha girls in the schoolyard, the coconut & rich texture bounces back and forth with the fruitiness of the apricot liqueur creating a balanced cocktail that is both refreshing and rich.

Free Spirited Cocktails.title: Heat of The Moment
Free Spirited Cocktails.desc: (Pineapple, passion fruit, berbere) The Caribbean meets Addis Ababa in this tantalizing, alcohol-free cocktail that will set your taste buds ablaze with its exotic appeal. Crafted with a harmonious blend of pineapple, passion fruit, and a dash of berbere spice, this mocktail promises an unforgettable journey of flavors

Free Spirited Cocktails.title: Golden Hour
Free Spirited Cocktails.desc: (Fresh carrot, fresh orange, ginger, bissana mar) Embrace the vibrant hues of the sun setting over Entoto as you savor the naturally sweet and earthy essence of freshly squeezed carrot, complemented by the zesty brightness of citrus, and the subtle heat and spiciness of ginger. In this elixir you will experience the beauty of the moment and all without a drop of alcohol

Free Spirited Cocktails.title: Honey Breeze
Free Spirited Cocktails.desc: (Fresh cucumber, pineapple, lime, honey, mint) High above the city on the 47th floor, where the air feels lighter and the skyline stretched endlessly. Honey Breeze was inspired by a moment of calm between the rush of life. A refreshing blend of crisp cucumber, sweet pineapple, fresh mint, golden honey, and a touch of lime comes together to create a drink that feels like a deep, revitalizing breath
